MULTIPORT FUEL INJECTION (MFI) <3.0L ENGINE>
13B-341
STEP 15. Check for leaks in the evaporator line from hose 
J to hose K.
(1) Disconnect hose J at the liquid separator side, and then 
connect a hand vacuum pump to the hose.
(2) Disconnect hose K at the fuel tank side, and then plug the 
hose.
(3) Apply vacuum by using the hand vacuum pump.
Q: Is the vacuum maintained inside the evaporator line?
YES : Go to Step 16.
NO : Go to Step 19.
STEP 16. Check for leaks in the evaporator line from hose 
P.
(1) Remove the fuel tank. (Refer to GROUP 13C, Fuel Tank 
P.13C-6.)
(2) The leakage test with a hand vacuum pump on each hose 
from hose P.
Q: Can the leaks be pinpointed?
YES : Replace that hose. Then go to Step 32.
NO : Go to Step 17.
